itemUsage.en: Nasti, Rhine Lab Collaborating Operator. A stern and meticulous engineer.
itemUsage.zh: 莱茵生命合作干员娜斯提，不苟言笑的工程师。

itemDesc.en: She hails from the Convallis of the Banshees, has traversed the frontier, and her future hangs high up in the sky.
itemDesc.zh: 她来自女妖河谷，也走过拓荒地，而她的未来高悬于天际。

description.en:
When this skill is equipped, Device grants the Operator in front extra DEF
<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK, <@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</> DEF, and simultaneously attacks all blocked enemies; Device grants <@ba.vup>+1</> Block to the Operator in front and <@ba.vup>+{talent@def:0%}</> DEF, but devices lose 2% Max HP every second
<@ba.rem>Gains 1 Device on skill activation</>
description.zh: 携带此技能时：装置使前方干员防御力提升\n攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，防御力<@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</>，同时攻击阻挡的所有敌人；装置效果改为使前方干员阻挡数<@ba.vup>+1</>，防御力<@ba.vup>+{talent@def:0%}</>，装置每秒流失2%最大生命值\n<@ba.rem>技能开启时获得一个装置</>

description.en:
When this skill is equipped, restores device HP over time after the device is deployed. On activation, the device loses 1 HP every 0.5 seconds, and grants the Operator in front <@ba.vup>1</> SP and a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{talent@shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</> of Nasti's Max HP.
Immediately activates the devices on the field. Stops attacking and gains a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@nasti_s2[update_shield].shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</> of her Max HP every 0.5 seconds. (Barrier cannot exceed {talent@shield_max_hp_rate:0%} of Max HP)
<@ba.rem>Gains 1 Device when skill ends</>
description.zh: 携带此技能时：装置部署后逐渐回复自身生命值，激活后每0.5秒流失1点生命值，使前方干员获得<@ba.vup>1</>点技力和相当于娜斯提生命上限<@ba.vup>{talent@shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</>的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>\n立即激活场上装置，停止攻击，每0.5秒获得相当于生命上限<@ba.vup>{attack@nasti_s2[update_shield].shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</>的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>（最多不超过生命上限{talent@shield_max_hp_rate:0%}）\n<@ba.rem>技能结束时获得一个装置</>

description.en: 'Director Nasti, I heard it took you only six months to go from joining Rhine Lab to leading Engineering?' 'Three.' 'Just... three months?' 'To be precise, Rhine Lab only established an official Engineering Section after I joined, to provide engineering support for the mountain of proposals from Muelsyse, Ferdinand, and the others. I joined the company in its early days, but after it had already attracted quite a lot of attention. And given my background... you could certainly say that three months was an especially short period for a Sarkaz who showed up out of nowhere to assume a regular role here.' 'You mean the vetting process went smoothly for you?' 'One of my people over at Maylander secretly helped me out. Of course, I only found out about that later.' 'Hiding your history must have been difficult.' 'Maybe you've been spending too much time listening to water-cooler rumors. The more time you waste on this routine interview, the more time I'll have to spend later 'hiding my history', as you put it. A young company like this—a young country like this—has always derived its nutrients from age-old secrets.' 'My apologies, Director Nasti. I-I'm just a little nervous. I thought you'd have declined the interview, or responded the way Director Muelsyse did. Only halfway through my interview with her did I realize I was talking to a water clone the whole time...' 'They don't have any function like that.' 'They? Oh, you're referring to the robots by your feet? According to HR's surveys, many of our employees are very interested in them... What should we call them?' 'Branch-type fully-loaded hybrid precision work robots. Each of them bears a unique eight-digit serial number indicating the scope of their respective duties. I have incantations inscribed on their core components so they can seamlessly adhere to my commands.' 'So I take it you're like their mother, Director?' 'No. They do whatever I want. They're merely the bricks and bolts of whatever project needs them. Just like me. Also, don't casually project such precious emotions onto inanimate objects.' '...' 'Alright, kid. You don't have to force yourself to think of any more questions to ask. Just leave the rest to me.' —Excerpt from a Rhine Lab HR Audio Log Thank god Director Jara showed up in the nick of time, before the mood in the room dropped below zero. To be honest, the Director of Engineering isn't that hard to get along with, other than her schedule being difficult to squeeze into. She's just focused on efficiency and her work, and I could be myself for the most part. The two of them soon shifted topics and began discussing Control. Probably Director Jara was subtly asking where Control was. 'This was your true motive for the interview, wasn't it?' The conversation continued, and I heard Director Nasti switch to an unusually gentler tone. 'Kristen doesn't want you to know too much. I understand her reasons, so I'll say nothing more on the matter.' It seems like I'll never get the chance to apologize to her. —Supplementary explanation from HR staff Jennifer
description.zh:
“娜斯提主任，听说您从加入莱茵生命，到成为工程科主任，只用了短短半年的时间？”
“三个月。”
“竟然……三个月？”
“准确说，我加入之后，莱茵生命才开始正式组建工程科，为缪尔赛思、斐尔迪南他们已经堆积如山的计划书提供工程支持。但我的身份特殊，那时还在初创期的莱茵已经吸引了不少人的目光，一个来历不明的萨卡兹要想正常工作不受干扰，三个月的时间，确实算短。”
“资质审查之类的？”
“有位在梅兰德的同胞暗中给过一点帮助。当然这是后来才知道的事情。”
“隐藏行迹很辛苦吧？”
“你可能听多了茶水间的传言。这种浪费时间的例行谈话越长，我接下来需要‘隐藏行迹’的时间也就越长。这个年轻的公司，甚至这个年轻的国家，没有一刻不在从古老的秘密中汲取养分。”
“非常抱歉，娜斯提主任。我、我有点紧张，我本来以为您会拒绝参加这次的例行人事谈话，或者像缪尔赛思主任一样应付我，谈话都进行一半了，我才发现坐在对面的是水分身……”
“它们没有这样的功能。”
“它们？哦，您是说您脚边的机器人。根据人事科的问卷调查结果，莱茵的很多员工都对它们很感兴趣……应该怎么称呼它们？”
“枝状全构件复合型精密作业机器人。它们每一个都有独特的八位字符编号，用于区分对应的作业范围。它们最核心的构件由我的咒言写就，因此可以无障碍接收我的指令。”
“我可以理解为，娜斯提主任是它们的母亲吗？”
“不可以。它们做我所想，和我一样，都是某些工程的螺钉或者砖石。以及，不要轻易在死物身上投注如此珍贵的情感。”
“……”
“好了孩子，不要硬着头皮找话题了，接下来的谈话我来就好。”
——摘自莱茵生命人事科录音

感谢神，在我让会议室的气氛滑向冰冷的深渊之前，雅拉主任及时出现了。
实话说，除了日程有点难约，这位工程科主任并不算多么难相处，她只是更专注工作、更注重效率而已，我大可以自然一些。
屋内两个人的话题迅速转到了总辖身上，大概是雅拉主任在旁敲侧击地询问总辖的行踪。
“雅拉，这才是例行谈话的真实目的吧？”谈话在继续，我听见娜斯提主任的声音难得地软了些，“克丽斯腾不希望你知晓太多。我理解她为什么这么做，所以，无可奉告。”
看来我是没机会向她道歉了。
——人事科员工珍妮弗的补充说明
